title: Switch State Spring
description: Bấm công tắc, núm trượt sang bằng lò xo nảy một nhịp, bị bóp dẹt giữa đường rồi tròn lại, rãnh đổi màu.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio switch-state-spring, written here): Track 88x44 r22, grey → accent crossfade with knob progress. Knob r17 travels +40 px (recipe 30 px at UI size) on spring k380 c20 from 0.4 s (about 15 % overshoot, one rebound, settled by ~560 ms); back at 1.5 s the same way. Squash during the first 0.2 s of each move: scaleX 1 → 0.76 → 1, scaleY 1 → 1.1 → 1 (half sine). Cursor presses 0.03 s before each move. Params: travel (40 px) · spring (k380 c20) · squash (0.76 × 1.1) · squash time (0.2 s). During the first 0.2 s of each move the knob squashes to scaleX 0.76, scaleY 1.1 (half sine); the track crossfades with the knob's progress.
